_scoring.method: Blind list per law from the marked packet text (instructions + LAW TEXT), saved before opening data/duties, data/powers, data/dropped, data/effective_dates; recall = (correct+wrong)/(correct+wrong+missed). Detection rules run over all 9 session files (20415 records).

_classes.name: non-body actor_raw (passive subject, sentence text or law description as actor)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\b(shall|must|disregard|provisions|the following)\b', actor_raw, re.I) over data/duties/*.json obligations + data/powers/*.json powers

_classes.name: duplicate record for one provision (overlapping quotes, same holder)
_classes.rule: pairs in the same matter_id with equal agency, agency_unit, kind, citation and deadline_kind, different quotes sharing at least one 12-word n-gram (catches 2015-S4978-08; 2013-S4800-01/02 share no n-gram and need judgment)

_classes.name: prohibition on a government actor stored as power
_classes.rule: kind=='power' and re.search(r'\b(no|not|nor)\b[^.;]{0,40}\bmay\b|\bmay not\b|\bshall not\b', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: missed sunset extension of an earlier chapter (amended act clause with braced year, no stored extension record)
_classes.rule: per law with stored records: a LAW TEXT paragraph matching 'This act shall take effect' + (expire|repealed|full force|cease to be) + a braced year or braced spelled year, and no stored record whose quote matches (expire|repealed|full force|cease to be); db_matches counts LAWS

_classes.name: eligibility-list item stored as a duty of the list ('The following libraries')
_classes.rule: re.search(r'^(the )?following\b', actor_raw, re.I) or re.match(r'^\d+\.\s', quote)

_classes.name: special-district election inspectors resolved to Boards of elections
_classes.rule: agency=='Boards of elections' and actor_raw matches (inspector|ballot clerk|chairperson) and quote+law_title matches (librar|fire district|water district|special district|improvement district|district election)

_classes.name: sunset extension of a private party's authority stored for a State agency
_classes.rule: no mechanical rule: requires judging whether the extended chapter's holder is private (title 'immunizing agents to be administered to adults by pharmacists')

2011-S7000-01.quote: Upon receipt of a petition signed by not less than twenty-five voters qualified to vote at a general election in the town, the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall conduct an election at which the issues shall be:

2011-S7000-02.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall give notice of such election by publication of notice at least twice in one or more newspapers having a general circulation in the district to be served.

2011-S7000-03.quote: In addition, the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall cause copies of such notice to be posted conspicuously in three public places in the district at least thirteen days prior to the date of such election.

2011-S7000-04.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall designate a resident qualified voter of such district to act as chairperson of any election of such district and shall designate not less than two nor more than four resident qualified voters to act as election inspectors and ballot clerks at such election.

2011-S7000-05.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library may adopt a resolution providing that such chairperson, election inspectors and ballot clerks shall be paid reasonable compensation for their respective services at such election.

2011-S7000-06.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library may, to the extent authorized by law, authorize the use of absentee ballots for the election.

2011-S7000-07.quote: After the polls have closed at such election, the election inspectors and the ballot clerks shall immediately canvass publicly the ballots cast and the chairperson of the election shall publicly announce the result.
2011-S7000-07.note: Inspectors are designated by the library board: 'the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall designate ... resident qualified voters to act as election inspectors and ballot clerks'; not a county board of elections.

2011-S7000-08.quote: Within seventy-two hours thereafter, the chairperson, election inspectors and ballot clerks shall execute and file a certificate of the result of the canvass with the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library and the town and village clerks.
2011-S7000-08.note: 'Within seventy-two hours thereafter' runs from the close of the polls, an undated event, not the effective date.

2011-S7000-09.quote: In the event that the district is created, there shall be an annual election conducted by the board of trustees of the Grinnell public library district in accordance with the provisions of subdivision one of this section at a time to be set by the board of trustees of the district
